posts.name: Rudra Mahesh Thakkar
posts.cooked: Hello sir, I’ve taken system commands this semester. I’ve missed the first two vm tasks. As I’ve read earlier, vm tasks are essential for OPPE in System commands.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Do you mean BPTs?
Yes BPTs are mandatory for being eligible for oppe. You have to repeat oppe or repeat entire course next term

posts.name: Rudra Mahesh Thakkar
posts.cooked:
As I understand it, VM task 1 and 2 are no longer available for submission. Currently BPT3 is accepting until 25th feb 2025. Hence, I’m ineligible for for OPPE-1.
Also, can I submit the remaining BPTs for OPPE-2? Will get a grade that way? In other words, will I be allowed to take final quiz for Sys com?
Thanks so much.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
There is only one OPPE in System Commands, during the time of OPPE-2.
For eligibility you need to submit first 3 BPTs. As deadline for first two is over, it is not possible this term.

posts.name: Rudra Mahesh Thakkar
posts.cooked:
So, the best I can do is to watch all the lectures and submit the assignments and learn the subject. I won’t get any grades.
Do I have to pay the entire fees when I retake it the next term?
Thanks for clarifying sir

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: No you can do repeat OPPE only and give Q1 and ET this term and OPPE next term. That costs less fees.
